signatures.description: Build a dynamic run-length-encoded Burrows-Wheeler transform index in Go that supports online text insertion at arbitrary positions using a rope-of-runs with split/merge, maintaining rank and select over the BWT (Fenwick-of-runs or wavelet-style) with correct run-boundary repair at every split and merge. The index must answer count and locate for arbitrary patterns after 10^5 mixed insertions, returning exact suffix-array offsets that match a rebuild-from-scratch reference on random, Fibonacci-string, and tandem-repeat inputs, and must expose the primary-index bookkeeping so an off-by-one at a run head is caught rather than silently tolerated. Report peak memory and rank operations per query, and prove the rope stays canonical (no adjacent equal-character runs) after the full workload.
